name: Bizora Tax Research
description:
Bizora is an AI native tax research platform. This connector brings Bizora's research engine into Claude, so you can ask a tax question in the middle of your actual work and get an answer grounded in primary source authority rather than secondary commentary.

Ask the question the way you would ask a colleague. Bizora interprets it, researches it against the governing authority, and returns a reasoned answer with citations you can open and verify yourself. Responses point back to the sources that control the issue, including the Internal Revenue Code, Treasury regulations, revenue rulings and revenue procedures, IRS guidance, and federal case law. State and international authority is included where the question calls for it.

Common uses:

- Researching a client position before you commit to it on a return
- Checking whether recent legislation or guidance changes an answer you already relied on
- Working through cross border and multistate questions where the authority is scattered
- Building the technical support behind a memo, a client email, or a workpaper
Getting oriented on an issue outside your usual specialty

Because the connector runs inside Claude, the research sits alongside the rest of your work. You can pull up a client email, research the question it raises, and draft the reply in one thread.

Every tool in this connector is read only. Bizora retrieves and analyzes tax authority and does not create, modify, or delete anything in your account.

Bizora is a research tool, not a substitute for professional judgment. Review the cited authority before relying on any answer in client work.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Bizora Tax Research to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Bizora Tax Research to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.api-bizora.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Bizora Tax Research MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bizora Tax Research provides these MCP tools: tax-research.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Bizora Tax Research?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Bizora Tax Research in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Bizora Tax Research MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bizora Tax Research requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Bizora Tax Research is developed by Bizora Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
